capabilities: Export Markdown notes to styled PDFs using named document profiles
Configure fonts, spacing, and colors per Markdown element
Preview the real PDF with matching page breaks before saving
Add headers and footers with placeholders like {{page}}, {{title}}, and YAML properties
Adjust table and image layout per note before export
extras: Desktop only (uses Electron printToPDF). README is bilingual (English and Korean). Add-ons are PDF-only and do not change how notes look in the editor. Developer accepts donations via Buy me a coffee.
problem: Obsidian's built-in printing gives little control over how headings, tables, callouts, and page furniture look in the resulting PDF.
summary: PDF export plugin that renders Markdown notes into styled PDFs with per-element typography, named document profiles, and a true print preview.
